_about: Five defined events, carried over from the prior session's measurement plan (names only; definitions to be confirmed under FLG-012). No identifiers, no cookies, no storage. Sent only when site.json has an analytics_endpoint.

events.name: page_view
events.payload: event name, page path (no query string), empty product id.
events.replaces: session_start (renamed; it never stored a session identifier in this rebuild).

events.name: disclosure_impression
events.fires: When the disclosure strip under the masthead is at least half visible.

events.name: product_impression
events.fires: When a product card is at least half visible (once per card per page).
events.payload: event name, page path, product id (P01…P05).

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires: A click on any link marked rel="sponsored" (product CTAs).
events.payload: event name, page path, product id.

privacy_rules: No cookies and no localStorage or sessionStorage writes.
No user identifiers, IP addresses or user agents stored by the receiver.
Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured: nothing is sent.
Only the five event names above are accepted; anything else is rejected.
